lines.zh: 蹄子踩在玄武岩上，火星四溅。
lines.en: My hooves strike basalt and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我低着头往前走，角先到。
lines.en: I walk head down; my horns arrive first.

lines.zh: 熔岩在脚边流，我不在乎。
lines.en: Lava runs by my feet. I do not care.

lines.zh: 这具身体比人高一头，肩很宽。
lines.en: This body stands a head above a man, shoulders broad.
Each step lands with a dull thud.
I pass along the lava shore.
I close in step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 灰烬落在我背上，很快烧掉。
lines.en: Ash lands on my back and burns away.
My breath heats the air.

lines.zh: 这是 2016 年那副身子，更沉。
lines.en: This is the 2016 body. Heavier.

lines.zh: 我绕过石柱，石柱被我碰塌。
lines.en: I pass a pillar and it collapses.
I do not run. I never run.

lines.zh: 我站着，胸口的火慢慢烧。
lines.en: I stand, the fire in my chest burning slowly.
The Nether wind carries sulfur.

lines.zh: 我把拳头握紧，骨头在响。
lines.en: I clench a fist and the bones crack.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有活物靠近。
lines.en: I am listening for anything alive.
A scrap of charred flesh hangs on my horn.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由，只需要敌人。
lines.en: I need no reason, only an enemy.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，喉咙里全是火。
lines.en: I open my mouth; fire fills my throat.
This lava field is mine.
My shadow stretches long in the firelight.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，看了看旧伤。
lines.en: I raise an arm and look at an old wound.
I do not tire, and I do not leave.
However much you wear, it will not help.
You will not last long in the Nether.
My horns are longer than your sword.
You back away; I take another step.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个站在这儿的。
lines.en: You are not the first to stand there.
You are panting. I hear it clearly.
I see your hand trembling.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那点火星。
lines.en: I know that spark in your hand.
A split opens in my hide, smoking.

lines.zh: 我的血是烫的，落在地上冒泡。
lines.en: My blood is hot and bubbles on the stone.

lines.zh: 你把我的角打歪了一点。
lines.en: You bent one of my horns slightly.
I look down at you, and the fire grows.
This wound has angered me.
My fist keeps rising.
A seam has split in my armor.

lines.zh: 这一击，我会连本带利还你。
lines.en: I'll repay this blow with interest.
You show food to a demon.

lines.zh: 这点分量，连火星都不够。
lines.en: That would not even make a spark.

lines.zh: 下界没有能喂饱我的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in the Nether can fill me.

lines.zh: 你这点东西，我闻都不闻。
lines.en: I will not even sniff it.

lines.zh: 别拿它挡在我和你之间。
lines.en: Do not hold it between us.

lines.zh: 那点能量，闻着像我的口粮。
lines.en: That energy smells like my rations.
Don't put it away; I haven't tasted it.

lines.zh: 你把能量举高，我就凑近。
lines.en: Raise the energy and I come closer.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞石墙。
lines.en: You struck my chest like a stone wall.
I did not step back.
My hide is harder than you think.
We left a hollow in the floor.
Do not walk against my leg.
I lower my head to look at you. Close.
Again, and I will grab you.

lines.zh: 撞上我的胸甲，你吃亏了。
lines.en: You hit my chest plate, and you lost.
Demons do not do such things.
I have only fire. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 这种话在下界没有意义。
lines.en: Such words mean nothing in the Nether.
My kind know only strength.
Flame does not breed.
I am here only to kill.
Leave. I am going to find the next one.
I have no interest in this.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块发红的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a glowing stone.
It cracks in my hand.
This is too heavy for a human.
I use it to smash things.
This flame, I crush it out.
I lift a bone and weigh it.

lines.zh: 亚金能源的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of Argent Energy.
I toss the pieces into the lava.
No one will come asking for it back.
I grip it and my gauntlet creaks.
I raise my fist slowly.

lines.zh: 你在我和熔岩之间，很好。
lines.en: You are between me and the lava. Good.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，火从牙缝喷出。
lines.en: I roar and fire sprays between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，这里是下界。
lines.en: You cannot run. This is the Nether.
Do not think these horns are decoration.
You cannot block this.

lines.zh: 你知道自己已经死了吗。
lines.en: Do you know you are already dead?
I will press you into the lava.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是越走越近。
lines.en: I do not chase. I simply keep closing in.

lines.zh: 你往哪退，下界都是我的地。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, the Nether is mine.
The path behind you narrows.
I do not look anywhere else.

lines.zh: 你踩着边缘走，我看见了。
lines.en: You skirt the edge. I see it.
I am measuring the distance. Accurately.
You have stopped to catch your breath.
The lava will seal the path for me.

lines.zh: 我一步踩塌了一块石台。
lines.en: One step and a ledge gives way.

lines.zh: 你绕的每个弯，我都在前面。
lines.en: Every turn you take, I am ahead.

lines.zh: 我又吼了一声，火喷到墙上。
lines.en: I roar again; fire hits the wall.

lines.zh: 我的拳头已经举过头顶。
lines.en: My fist is already above my head.
Two steps left.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸下来，地面塌了。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the ground gives way.

lines.zh: 这一掌把你推开好几格。
lines.en: This palm throws you back several blocks.
My horns take you in the chest.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，往下一扯。
lines.en: I seize your arm and wrench it down.
This blow has no trick to it.
My knee drives into your ribs.

lines.zh: 火从我的拳头里喷出来。
lines.en: Fire sprays from my fist.
I stomp and the stone shatters.
You are slapped against the rock wall.
That was only the beginning.

lines.zh: 你飞出去了，撞断了柱子。
lines.en: You fly out and break a pillar.
I lift my foot to stomp again.
Still standing? Interesting.
This blow is a return gift.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩里站起来，全身是火。
lines.en: I rise out of the lava, covered in fire.
My first breath is sulfur.
The stone crumbles under me.
My horns break the ground first.
This is the Nether. I know it.

lines.zh: 亚金的火在体内烧起来。
lines.en: Argent fire ignites inside me.
I raise my head and see a red sky.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了一片熔岩。
lines.en: My shadow covers a stretch of lava.
I try a fist; the joints lock.
But I know what to do.
I head toward whatever lives.
Fire is only warmth to me, not pain.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，砸穿了石台。
lines.en: I fall from above and break through a ledge.

lines.zh: 水？下界没有水，你在做梦。
lines.en: Water? There is none here. You are dreaming.
Something is stuck in my shoulder plate.
A curse crawls under my hide, stinging.
I do not hunger, yet the body empties.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的角走遍全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my horns through me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有熔岩，也没有地。
lines.en: No lava below, no ground at all.
